title: Plumb recipe pack, format 1
description: A versioned, licensed bundle of named shadow and motion recipes. See docs/research/recipe-pack.md.

id.description: Globally unique pack id: publisher.pack, lowercase.

namespace.description: Prefix for every CSS custom property and class this pack writes: --<namespace>-<token>. Unique per pack in one theme; the installer may override it.

licence.description: Licence of what the pack's author wrote (structure, original values, formulas). Third-party values keep their own licence in recipes[].source.

spdx.description: SPDX id, or LicenseRef-... for a custom one.

requiresPlumb.description: Semver range of the Plumb pack-reader this pack needs, e.g. ^1.0.0.

notices.description: Attribution and licence texts the installer must write next to the tokens it emits (one entry per distinct upstream licence).

formula.description: Arithmetic over dial ids and variable names: numbers, + - * / %, parentheses, and min, max, clamp(x,lo,hi), round(x,step), abs, sin(deg), cos(deg), pow, sqrt, mix(a,b,t). No other identifiers; no side effects.

template.description: A CSS value or rule text. {{ formula }} inserts a number. {var:token} becomes var(--<ns>-token). {prop:token} becomes --<ns>-token. {class:name} becomes <ns>-name.

dark.description: Only when dark differs from light.

tailwind.description: Optional Tailwind v4 theme variable to alias this token to, so utilities such as shadow-raised exist.

label.description: Plain words shown on the dial.

default.description: At the default, every token equals the source library's value (unless source.copied is 'original').

drives.description: Variables or tokens whose formula reads this dial. Must match the formulas (the reader checks).

tailwind.description: Equivalent Tailwind v4 utility classes, when they exist.

css.description: Whole rules: selectors, @keyframes, @starting-style, view-transition pseudo-elements, media queries.

props.description: Props for a motion/react component: initial, animate, exit, whileHover, whileTap, whileFocus, layout, layoutId, transition. String leaves are templates.

name.description: Plain words people see, e.g. Raised, Pop in.

licence.description: SPDX id of the source, or 'none' for original values.

attribution.description: Exact credit line the installer writes into the theme.

copied.description: values: copied as published. adapted: published values reshaped into dials. original: authored here, the source only names the technique.

verified.description: true only when the value was read from the source file or page and the licence from its licence file.

uses.description: Recipe ids in the same pack whose tokens this recipe reads.

variables.description: Named intermediate values, computed from dials and earlier variables, used inside {{ }} in token and apply templates.

requires.description: none: at least one apply entry works with plain CSS. motion: every apply entry needs the motion library.

reducedMotion.description: What this becomes under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. Shadows: 'unchanged'.

states.description: Which states the preview must show, e.g. rest, hover.
